provenance: Owned synthetic black-box Salesforce observations on a plain Developer scratch org. Each request and test source was pinned to its matrix API. Anonymous execution and named check-only test observations are independent. Stable semantic labels and the test class name replace capture transport identifiers; all native payload values are retained. Object metadata combines the accepted deployed components, identical across these APIs. No org identity, credentials or private source is included. CI executes locally without contacting Salesforce.
